ActionFrame.description:
The `data` of one SSE frame of `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/actions` (ТЗ Ф4 §4.7); the SSE
event name is `FRAME_EVENTS[type(frame)]`. The `: keepalive` comment is not a frame.
ActionFrame.title: ActionFrame

ActionRecordedFrame.description: `action_recorded {seq, verdict?}`: right after the action event is committed.
ActionRecordedFrame.title: ActionRecordedFrame

AnswerAction.description: `answer.submitted` (+ instant verdict in the same transaction, Т-§6.1).
AnswerAction.title: AnswerAction

ArtifactResponse.description: An artifact at its current version; blocks with the names of Т-§17.2.
ArtifactResponse.title: ArtifactResponse

Block.description: П-9.4: task (condition and room for the solution), visualization, hint, reference card.
Block.title: Block

CanvasRef.description: A canvas line or block picked by the lasso (Т-§15.6).
CanvasRef.title: CanvasRef

CardsResponse.description: The topic's cards at the current version; `card_id` is the task to answer.
CardsResponse.title: CardsResponse

CheatsheetResponse.description: The sheet at its current version and whether to offer it now (D-C-144).
CheatsheetResponse.title: CheatsheetResponse

ChoiceElement.description: Вопрос с выбором: options are in the task spec (`answer.options`).
ChoiceElement.title: ChoiceElement

ClientParams.description: Numbers of the client from the server config (ТЗ Ф4 §6.7).
ClientParams.title: ClientParams

ConsentResponse.description: The consent request; a repeat with the same key gives the same one.
ConsentResponse.title: ConsentResponse

DeletionResponse.description: The id of the deletion and the term the copies still live (Д-§8.6).
DeletionResponse.title: DeletionResponse

DomainGraphResponse.description:
`projected_seq` — how far the graph has read the log; `lag_degraded` — it is behind the
learner's last event (the map may miss the latest events, Т-§2.6).
DomainGraphResponse.title: DomainGraphResponse

DomainSuggestion.description:
`existing` — `domain_id` of the learner's domain; `new` — `name` of a new domain;
`unclear` — nothing is suggested.
DomainSuggestion.title: DomainSuggestion

DomainSummary.description: A domain of the learner, from its `domain.created` (ТЗ Ф4 §6.1).
DomainSummary.title: DomainSummary

EditHub.description:
`topics` — the whole new scope with required levels (empty levels — by `controlType`,
WP6.3); `deadline_at_ms` — the new date, `null` removes it. At least one of them.
EditHub.title: EditHub

Edited.description: The number of the appended event.
Edited.title: Edited

ElementFrame.description: `element {block_id, element}`: after its markup passed the code check.
ElementFrame.title: ElementFrame

ElementResponseAction.description: `element.responded` (+ `answer.submitted` if the element is a task).
ElementResponseAction.title: ElementResponseAction

ErrorFrame.description: `error {code, message, retryable}`: an error before the write — no turn in the log.
ErrorFrame.title: ErrorFrame

EventAccepted.description: The number of the appended event (the learner's change, Т-§2.8).
EventAccepted.title: EventAccepted

EvidenceFact.description:
One piece of evidence for a level (Т-§8.7): quote, task, tier by code, date, id for
the "disagree" action (Т-§2.8). `assistance` / `hint_step` — the help given (Evidence
`assistance`, `hintStep`, `Т-§3.4.3`), `skill_history` shows it (`Т-§10.4`, D-A-127).
EvidenceFact.title: EvidenceFact

ExportStatus.description:
`pending` — requested, the archive is not ready; `ready` — `download_url` lives
`expires_in_s`; `expired` — the archive is deleted or past its term (build a new one).
ExportStatus.title: ExportStatus

FeedEvent.description: An event of the session feed (`GET /v1/sessions/{id}`, D-B-210).
FeedEvent.title: FeedEvent

FreeAnswerElement.description:
Свободный ответ, «объясни своими словами»: the rubric is in the task spec
(`answer.key_ideas`); the answer is text or voice.
FreeAnswerElement.title: FreeAnswerElement

Hint.description: A quiet hint near the place where the learner is stuck, one step at a time (П-9.5).
Hint.title: Hint

HubGoal.description:
A goal hub of a domain for slot 4 (Т-§10.1, WP14.1): read from the graph, so merges,
splits and renames of topics are already applied (D-A-137).
HubGoal.title: HubGoal

HubReadiness.description: `topic_readiness` (Т-§14.5): "9 of 14 topics are ready", direct basis only.
HubReadiness.title: HubReadiness

HubTopicGoal.description: A topic of a hub with the levels the control requires of it (Т-§4.8, `INCLUDES`).
HubTopicGoal.title: HubTopicGoal

IntentAction.description:
«Изучать / Практиковать / Повторять» on a topic or a hub (Т-§12.7) →
`message.sent {intent, topic_id | hub_id}` (ТЗ Ф4 WP13.1).
IntentAction.title: IntentAction

LLMAccess.description:
D-B-211: `mode` of the money pool; `judge` — the learner said «I am a Meta judge»;
`blocked` — the client shows the banner with the one button (`preference_key` = true).
LLMAccess.title: LLMAccess

Layout.description: Where a block lies and whether it is collapsed (П-9.4 «двигать, сворачивать»).
Layout.title: Layout

LearnerAnswer.description:
`answer.submitted.answer` (§6.3): raw `value` (option id for `choice`), `latex` /
`sympy` from the formula editor or the recognizer (Т-§6.5, Т-§22.7).
LearnerAnswer.title: LearnerAnswer

LearnerDrawing.description:
A drawing cut from a sheet photo (WP22.3 step 5; Т-§16.3 п.4, D-C-153): the image without
its paper in the store and the box of the area as shares of the sheet.
LearnerDrawing.title: LearnerDrawing

LearnerLayer.description:
The learner's strokes are in the journal; here — what the learner typed and the drawings
cut from the photos of the sheet.
LearnerLayer.title: LearnerLayer

LearnerSkillPatch.description: Fields not given stay as they are; a change is a new version.
LearnerSkillPatch.title: LearnerSkillPatch

LineCorrection.description: WP21.3: how the line really reads (`Т-§22.7`: LaTeX to show, SymPy to check).
LineCorrection.title: LineCorrection

LinkSent.description: The same answer for a known and a new address (WP18.1).
LinkSent.title: LinkSent

Mark.description: A mark on a step (WP21.5): `error` confirmed, `question` when unsure (Т-§12.4).
Mark.title: Mark

MaterialLinkElement.description: Ссылка на материал: a chunk label (`P…`) and its page or slide.
MaterialLinkElement.title: MaterialLinkElement

MathValue.description: Т-§22.7: `latex` for display, `sympy` — canonical SymPy string for checking.
MathValue.title: MathValue

MessageAction.description:
`message.sent`: text, attached materials, canvas references, `/skill` call (Т-§17.8).

`voice_seq` - the message is spoken: the `seq` of its `voice.transcribed` (the answer of
`POST …/voice`). The words are that event's, so `text` must stay empty.
MessageAction.title: MessageAction

PaceWarning.description: `Т-§14.6`: the hub will not be ready by its date at the current pace.
PaceWarning.title: PaceWarning

PairElement.description:
Пара на различение: two task elements whose markups point at each other
(`pairTaskId`).
PairElement.title: PairElement

PairingIssued.description: WP22.1: the frontend builds the QR with a link carrying `token` (Т-§16.1).
PairingIssued.title: PairingIssued

Place.description:
«Места в сессиях» (`Т-§4.7`, `П-3.3`): an exposure or an evidence of a skill of the
topic — its session and the number of its event.
Place.title: Place

PlotSpec.description: A simple plot of one function (Т-§12.3 «простой график»).
PlotSpec.title: PlotSpec

PredictionElement.description: Предсказание: a question before a step of the explanation.
PredictionElement.title: PredictionElement

ReplayView.description: Signed links to the stroke chunks of the canvas, oldest first (Т-§15.7, D-C-135).
ReplayView.title: ReplayView

ResetFrame.description: `reset {reason}`: the shown part is replaced by «уточняю…» (Т-§12.2 этап 3).
ResetFrame.title: ResetFrame

ReviewResponse.description: The sheet after the review; `remarks` — the system blocks added to the learner's sheet.
ReviewResponse.title: ReviewResponse

Scaffold.description: A scaffold of the solution with gaps the learner fills with the pen (П-9.5).
Scaffold.title: Scaffold

ScaffoldElement.description:
Каркас с пропусками: every gap is a part of the task spec (Т-§5.2); `target` —
chat or a block in the teacher layer of the canvas (Т-§15.1).
ScaffoldElement.title: ScaffoldElement

SearchHitView.description: WP20.5: the session, `seq`, the snippet and the type of a found event.
SearchHitView.title: SearchHitView

SessionDetail.description: `GET /v1/sessions/{id}`: the session and its feed of events by `seq` (D-B-210).
SessionDetail.title: SessionDetail

SessionJob.description: A row of the learner's plaque (Т-§13.8): a visible job of the session.
SessionJob.title: SessionJob

ShortAnswerElement.description: Короткий ответ: the answer type and spec are in the task.
ShortAnswerElement.title: ShortAnswerElement

SignedIn.description: Without `auth_success_redirect_url` (D-C-105) sign-in answers 200 with the cookie.
SignedIn.title: SignedIn

SkillChange.description:
`before` is `None` for a skill that did not exist before the session; `after` is `None`
when the skill is no longer read under this id (merged away).
SkillChange.title: SkillChange

SkillCodes.description: The state of a skill in codes — no names, no weights, no times.
SkillCodes.title: SkillCodes

StartSession.description: `POST /v1/sessions` (WP13.10): the domain, the intent, a topic or a hub.
StartSession.title: StartSession

StatusFrame.description: `status`: `thinking` after admission; `tool` with the tool name on each tool call.
StatusFrame.title: StatusFrame

TaskDone.description:
A task of the session: answers given, the deepest hint step shown, the outcome of the
last verdict and how it was closed (`None` — left open).
TaskDone.title: TaskDone

TaskElement.description: Задача, with the «solve on the canvas» button.
TaskElement.title: TaskElement

TimedQuizElement.description: Пробник с таймером: task elements and the time.
TimedQuizElement.title: TimedQuizElement

TodayView.description:
Empty `items` — no plaque (`Т-§14.4`). `grade_hub_ids` — hubs whose date has passed
and that have no grade yet: the offer to enter it (WP17.5).
TodayView.title: TodayView

TopicDisplay.description:
The state of a topic in codes (ТЗ Ф4 WP6.2, `Т-§8.6`, `Т-§22.2`): one model for the
projector (phase C writes it as `displayState`, `displayReason`, `displayLevel`,
`displayDomainId`), the API and the context renderer. `displayReason` — the skill or the
misconception the rule fired on (`Т-§8.7`), "" — none; `displayLevel` 0, `displayDomainId`
"" — not given (law 8). Proposed, hidden and off-domain topics have `none`.
TopicDisplay.title: TopicDisplay

TopicNodeView.description: A topic on the map: the state is the code and its parameters, never a sentence.
TopicNodeView.title: TopicNodeView

TopicRequires.description: A derived link between topics (Т-§4.6); weight — the number of skill links.
TopicRequires.title: TopicRequires

TypedFormula.description: A formula typed in a typing block (`typed_formula {block_id, latex}`, WP21.2).
TypedFormula.title: TypedFormula

VerdictFrame.description: `verdict`: a fast verdict that came during the turn (Т-§6.1).
VerdictFrame.title: VerdictFrame

Visualization.description: A visualization laid next to the solution (П-9.5; artifact `Т-§13.6`).
Visualization.title: Visualization

VisualizationElement.description:
Визуализация, демо: a ready artifact (agent request label `R…`, Т-§13.6) or a simple
plot; exactly one is set.
VisualizationElement.title: VisualizationElement

VoiceView.description: WP21.6: what was heard; `seq` is the `voice.transcribed` event, `null` for silence.
VoiceView.title: VoiceView

WhyChoiceElement.description: «Почему» как выбор: 3–4 reasonings and «other» (П-4.5); options in the task spec.
WhyChoiceElement.title: WhyChoiceElement

WhyFacts.description: `why` (Т-§8.7): the deciding evidence of the level and the latest `why_recent_n`.
WhyFacts.title: WhyFacts

post.description:
WP21.6: one segment of speech (WAV) with its start and end by the device clock; the
audio is not stored (П-14.1). The companion has no voice (T-CP1: 403). A session of another
learner is 404; compressed audio is 415; the same segment again gives the same answer.
Larger than `upload_max_mb` is 413 before the body is read (Т-§19.8, as photos).
